description: Change a JSON file (such as an aos configuration or job) from a short instruction. First inspect the file one level at a time to find the places to change, then generate only the new value for each place. Validate format and shape before writing. Return the places visited and the changes made.

file.description: JSON file relative to the workspace, for example agent/fsm.json. It must remain inside the workspace after resolving symlinks; absolute paths, .. components and # are rejected.

want.description: One short instruction describing the change, for example: set the think state timeout to 30 seconds.
